### 🔵 Needs a closer look It spans cross-platform persistence and native command/permission boundaries, which warrants final human review to confirm security and UX expectations across all shells.
Pull request overview Adds an explicit, policy-safe “node config” contract and enforces strict routing/persistence boundaries across browser and native shells, aligning with PER-280’s goal of preventing accidental credential-surface broadening while keeping node routing policy durable. **Changes:** - Introduces `@aurora/client/node-config` (document model + sanitization/migration + routing resolution) and exports it via the SDK package exports. - Persists browser node policy in the origin-bound encrypted vault (with legacy metadata migration) and wires it into browser persistence flows. - Adds a narrow native storage boundary (`aurora_node_config_{get,set,delete}`) across Rust/Tauri + Android + iOS, plus capabilities/permission coverage and policy tests.

entrypoint. | | packages/aurora-ui/tests/node-config-persistence.test.ts | New tests for encrypted vault persistence + legacy metadata migration + fail-closed behavior. | | packages/aurora-ui/src/browser-peer-persistence.ts | Adds async save/load APIs for node config using encrypted vault storage. | | packages/aurora-ui/src/browser-peer-persistence-keys.ts | Introduces browser key constant mapped to the shared `aurora.nodeConfig.v1` storage key. | | packages/aurora-sdk/tests/node-config.test.ts | Extensive unit coverage for config document validation/migration + routing decisions + Tauri store boundary. | | packages/aurora-sdk/src/tauri.ts | Adds node-config command names + transport methods for the new native boundary. | | Implements `aurora_node_config_{get,set,delete}` commands and registers them. | | apps/aurora-tauri/src-tauri/permissions/aurora-node-config.toml | New permission bundle for the node-config command boundary. | | apps/aurora-tauri/src-tauri/ios/AuroraNativePlugin/.../AuroraThinPeerStorage.swift | Adds iOS UserDefaults-backed node config get/set/delete implementation + error code. | | apps/aurora-tauri/src-tauri/ios/AuroraNativePlugin/.../AuroraNativePlugin.swift | Wires iOS plugin commands + capability flags for node config. | | apps/aurora-tauri/src-tauri/capabilities/aurora-*.json | Grants the new `aurora-node-config` permission across relevant native capability manifests. | | apps/aurora-tauri/src-tauri/build.rs | Includes node-config commands in the allowlist used during build. | | apps/aurora-tauri/SECURITY.md | Documents the new node-config boundary and how it avoids broad credential storage exposure. |
